hypotheses.claim: Approach distance does not alter subsequent open-arena locomotion beyond ordinary stochastic variation.
The short/long difference is explained by different measured arena-entry conditions without a persistent internal state.
requires: raw initial trajectory frames or measured entry heading/speed distributions

hypotheses.claim: Sustained constrained travel creates a decaying directional-persistence state that survives entry into the arena.
requires: fitting unlock or independent prior constraints

screening_decision.rule: H0 is screening-incompatible when at least two primary structural metric contrasts fall outside the descriptive 95% bootstrap intervals and the observed contrast signs are stable under leave-one-colony-out recalculation.
screening_decision.warning: This is a descriptive model screen, not a formal inferential test and not biological parameter fitting.
